FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Smith, Compliance Officer, CareerLink Staffing Solutions, (555) 123-4567, john.smith@careerlinkstaffing.com
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At CareerLink Staffing Solutions, our core operations revolve around connecting qualified candidates with employers seeking to fill various roles across multiple industries. We specialize in both temporary and permanent placements, ensuring that each candidate is thoroughly vetted through background checks and eligibility verification to comply with all applicable regulations. Our agency maintains all necessary state and federal licenses to operate legally, ensuring a reliable and professional service for both clients and candidates. We prioritize safety and compliance by conducting risk assessments and providing proper training for candidates placed in high-risk environments. Additionally, we emphasize the importance of clear communication, providing written contracts that outline terms of service and responsibilities for all parties involved. Our commitment to confidentiality and data security ensures that all candidate and client information is handled with the utmost care, following relevant privacy laws. Ultimately, our goal is to facilitate successful employment matches that benefit both job seekers and employers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Date: 03/15/2021; Cause: Legal claim due to alleged negligent hiring; Amount: $3,000; Status: Closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security patrols and monitored alarm systems to safeguard premises and ensure the safety of personnel and assets.

FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The compliance officer, John Smith, checks all certificates to ensure they meet the necessary requirements.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – CareerLink Staffing Solutions has not had any applicants indicted or convicted of fraud, bribery, arson, or related crimes in connection with any property. We maintain a thorough vetting process for all candidates to ensure compliance and safety.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years for CareerLink Staffing Solutions. All coverage has been maintained without issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – CareerLink Staffing Solutions does not lease employees to or from other employers. Our focus is solely on providing staffing and placement services directly to clients.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – CareerLink Staffing Solutions currently maintains a Workers' Compensation policy to ensure compliance and protect our employees. Our active policy is in place and covers all necessary requirements for our operations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – CareerLink Staffing Solutions also operates CareerLink Administrative Services, which provides supportive administrative functions to enhance our staffing services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – CareerLink Staffing Solutions does not have any other insurance policies with this company. Currently, the only policy listed is the active general liability policy.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – CareerLink Staffing Solutions is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our primary focus is on staffing and placement services across various industries.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – CareerLink Staffing Solutions does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our operations focus exclusively on staffing and placement services without engaging in equipment rental.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – There have been no foreclosures, repossessions, bankruptcies, judgments, or liens during the past five years for CareerLink Staffing Solutions.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – CareerLink Staffing Solutions does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on staffing and placement services, which do not involve such materials.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – CareerLink Staffing Solutions does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations are focused solely on staffing and placement services, which do not involve activities that pose catastrophic risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: Yes – There was a past legal claim related to alleged negligent hiring, which resulted in a loss of $3,000 and has since been closed. However, the agency has implemented measures to enhance its hiring processes and ensure compliance.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – CareerLink Staffing Solutions has no uncorrected fire code violations, ensuring compliance with all fire safety regulations.
